_comment: Box coordinates are in pixels of your LANDSCAPE recording. Estimated from your OBS screenshot (1920x1080). The --still preview tells you if they're right; tweak and re-run.
_comment_cam_avoid: cam_box frames the FACE into the top slot (head only). cam_avoid_box is the FULL camera PiP - shoulders/arm included - that must NEVER leak into the bottom content. cam_safe_margin pads it. Measured from raw_frame.png: PiP runs top down to ~480px. crop_size (580) + margin (16) keep the square just small enough to glide BELOW the cam, so it follows the cursor on the right/bottom smoothly instead of pinning. Constraint: crop_size + cam_safe_margin <= 600.
